function: Excluded for function: the learned CNN only classifies UAV versus bird from micro-Doppler and range-profile images of radar echoes (sensing target recognition, p. 1 and p. 10); no beam, waveform, resource or communication function is learned.
notes: Exclusion code function. Abstract (p. 1): "we propose an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and bird recognition scheme with signal processing and deep learning for integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) system". The only learned element is a dual-input CNN that takes a micro-Doppler spectrum image and a range-profile image and outputs two classes, UAV or bird (p. 10); the metric is recognition accuracy (p. 11). p. 3: "we will ignore the communications stage and focus on how to use ISAC system to realize UAV and bird recognition". This is target classification, in the same family as signal or emitter identification and sensing alone; it does not design beams, waveforms or resources that serve sensing and communication (area 5), nor any other area. The beam directions are set to point at the target, not learned (p. 6). Rules 1 to 4 do not apply: it is a research article, the CNN is learned, and it acts on radar echo images, not above the physical layer. The setup (8x8 arrays at 26 GHz, p. 10) is multi-antenna, and quantitative simulation results are reported (p. 12), so rules 6 and 7 are not the reason.
